info.title: AlgoLearn implementation API
info.description: Same-origin cookie API. Flattened topic/problem IDs resolve course scope on the server; this replaces redundant course IDs in illustrative PRD paths. JSON request maximum 2 MiB. Byte caps are enforced independently. Extended list/report shapes are described in api_contract.md.

get.description: Course and ownership authorization is enforced from the referenced object. Student reads require published content. Correct quiz answers are present only after submission; hidden execution cases expose only position/hidden/verdict. Lists are bounded.

default.description: 400 malformed JSON; 401 no session; 403 role/Origin/CSRF; 404 missing/inaccessible object; 409 conflict/archived/idempotency; 413 body limit; 422 validation/publication; 429 rate/queue limits; 503 unavailable infrastructure.

post.summary: Register a pending student and request email activation
post.description: Generic accepted response for new and existing emails. Never overwrites existing accounts or grants staff roles/enrollment. Pending students receive a single-use 24-hour activation link; password is set after verification. Rate limited, exact Origin required.

202.description: Registration request accepted; does not disclose account existence

default.description: 400 malformed JSON; 401 no session; 403 role/Origin/CSRF; 404 missing/inaccessible object; 409 conflict/archived/idempotency; 413 body limit; 422 validation/publication; 429 rate/queue limits; 503 unavailable infrastructure.
